746780101.text: Unauthorized combat, unauthorized combat! Seize them immediately!

746780102.text: Upon discovering such a dangerous Domain, you should have reported it straight back to the Maison Gardiennage, not started an unauthorized investigation, let alone used violence... You really are a bloodthirsty one, aren't you?

746780103.text: B—B—B—But please! Not only are we not in the Court of Fontaine, but we're beating up monsters! Can we really be arrested for that?

746780104.text: Are you a registered member of the Adventurers' Guild?

746780105.text: N—No, I'm not... I didn't have what it takes to pass their physical tests...

746780106.text: Then presumably you informed the Maison Gardiennage in advance that you planned on using weapons within the borders of Fontaine?

746780107.text: Huh? You have to declare in advance that you're planning to use weapons?

746780108.text: Of course you do! If any old Pierre, Paul, or Jacques could start a fight in Fontaine whenever they wanted, where would that leave the Maison Gardiennage?

746780109.text: Waving weapons around like toys without a permit, you're lucky that the Gardemeks didn't treat you like an intruder!

746780110.text: Take a good look at yourself! You're practically a fake Fontainian. Do you seriously think us arresting you would be some grave miscarriage of justice?

746780111.text: I've completely misjudged this whole thing! As a writer, I selected my source material poorly, and should have known better than to overlook the basic setting of the story... A complete dereliction of duty!

746780114.text: But it's been ages since we became adventurers, so there shouldn't be a problem, right?

746780115.text: Oh? It's you two! You're both A-listers!

746780116.text: Ahem, my name is Enghiene and I am a veteran member of the Gardes with years of experience out in the wilds. A short time ago, while patrolling nearby, I caught sight of this reckless fellow...

746780117.text: He explained the ins and outs of why he's been loitering around here, and showed me this strange Domain. He also informed me that the two of you were taking part in this "Blade Dance" of his.
